The '''Second Battle of Nyriaan''' was a battle that was fought in the [[Luire system]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], for control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] defeated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[First Battle of Nyriaan]] and seized control of Nyriaan, and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a combined Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike force was sent to recapture the world. The Republic force arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and after a short battle, the Confederacy was defeated. However, soon after the fighting had ended, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared the enactment of the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency order]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and as a result, all Jedi that were known to be in the system were [[Death/Legends|killed]].
